The public license key for your company license, obtained from the License keys page on [remotion.pro](https://remotion.pro/dashboard). If you are eligible for the free license, pass "free-license".

## CLI flag

Use `--public-license-key` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                               | Flag                           |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio) | `--public-license-key <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render) | `--public-license-key <value>` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)   | `--public-license-key <value>` |
